title: Identifying a conserved transcriptional signature of drought and salt stress in Arabidopsis thaliana through meta-analysis, consensus network analysis, and deep learning.
one_liner_zh: 该文用元分析、共表达网络和深度学习识别拟南芥干旱盐胁迫转录特征，虽涉及转录因子但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或结合机制研究，仅属转录组学与表达分类，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: Understanding plant responses to abiotic stress is critical for improving stress resilience. Here, we performed an integrative analysis that uniquely converges three synergistic approaches: meta-analysis, consensus network analysis, and deep learning on Arabidopsis thaliana transcriptomic datasets under drought and salt conditions, comprising 64 samples across multiple studies. This novel framework allowed us to robustly identify 576 differentially expressed genes (397 upregulated, 170 downregulated), including At5g59310 (LTP4) as the most induced and At1g22690 (GASA9) as the most repressed. Functional annotation revealed that upregulated genes were enriched in stress-related pathways, including oxidoreductase and UDP-glycosyltransferase activities, while downregulated genes were associated with growth, hormone signaling, and photosynthesis. Among DEGs, 60 transcription factors spanning 15 families were identified, highlighting the central role of NAC, ERF, WRKY, bHLH, and bZIP families in stress regulation. Consensus co-expression network analysis revealed four modules with coordinated responses across both stresses, reflecting a growth-defense trade-off. Leveraging a deep learning pipeline featuring an Autoencoder for feature extraction and an MLP for classification, we distinguished stress versus normal samples with 94% accuracy and near-perfect AUC (0.992). Crucially, the convergence of these three methods pinpointed three high-confidence hub genes (At2g30250, At2g35070, and At2g30010), which were validated against independent RNA-seq datasets as core components of a general stress response. This work not only presents a powerful analytical blueprint but also delivers validated, high-priority genetic targets for direct application in engineering climate-resilient crops, with At2g35070 and At2g30010 emerging as particularly promising novel biomarkers.
abstract_zh: 理解植物对非生物胁迫的响应对于提高胁迫耐受性至关重要。在此，我们进行了一项整合分析，该分析独特地融合了三种协同方法：荟萃分析、共识网络分析和深度学习，应用于拟南芥在干旱和盐胁迫条件下的转录组数据集，涵盖多个研究中的64个样本。这一新颖框架使我们能够稳健地鉴定出576个差异表达基因（397个上调，170个下调），其中At5g59310（LTP4）为诱导最强烈的基因，At1g22690（GASA9）为抑制最显著的基因。功能注释显示，上调基因富集于胁迫相关通路，包括氧化还原酶和UDP-糖基转移酶活性，而下调基因则与生长、激素信号传导和光合作用相关。在差异表达基因中，鉴定出跨越15个家族的60个转录因子，突显了NAC、ERF、WRKY、bHLH和bZIP家族在胁迫调控中的核心作用。共识共表达网络分析揭示了四个模块，在两种胁迫下表现出协调响应，反映了生长-防御权衡。利用深度学习流程，该流程采用自编码器进行特征提取和MLP进行分类，我们以94%的准确率和接近完美的AUC（0.992）区分了胁迫与正常样本。关键的是，这三种方法的汇聚精确定位了三个高置信度枢纽基因（At2g30250、At2g35070和At2g30010），并通过独立RNA-seq数据集验证为一般胁迫响应的核心组成部分。这项工作不仅提供了一个强大的分析蓝图，还提供了经过验证的高优先级遗传靶点，可直接应用于工程化气候适应性作物，其中At2g35070和At2g30010作为特别有前景的新型生物标志物脱颖而出。
